cohort.selection_rule: every Lumid active-roster Polymarket condition with positive roster 24-hour volume, pre-2026-09-02 warehouse metadata, a nonempty question, exactly one canonical YES asset, and end_date at or after 2026-10-30T00:00:00Z

data_policy.authoritative_source: Lumid bounded warehouse retrieval with joined provenance
data_policy.live_news_collector: diagnostic backup only because news/latest cap alarms are unresolved
data_policy.news_clock: max(published_at, ingest_ts, joined run.started_at, joined run.ended_at when present)
data_policy.source_completeness_failure: confirmatory B1-B3 incomplete; never encode missing news as zero

models.b2: B1 plus relevance and market-relative novelty
models.b3: B2 plus publisher diversity and exact-headline cross-publisher diffusion
